page_title: LYO 1-0 NAN | Lyon v Nantes 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Tino Kadewere (Lyon) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+6' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+6' Clinton Mata (Lyon) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+3' A substitution has been made. Douglas Augusto goes off and Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) comes on.
90+2' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
89' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes it short.
89' A quickly taken corner by Nantes.
88' Alexandre Lacazette goes off the pitch and Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) comes on.
88' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Rayan Cherki will be replaced by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon).

85' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the left post. Poor header! The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
84' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Dejan Lovren (Lyon) has to leave the pitch!
82' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Dejan Lovren (Lyon)! Let's see what he decides.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tino Kadewere (Lyon) replaces Ernest Nuamah.
82' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alban Lafont reads it well and gathers the ball.
79' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
77' Lyon take a short corner kick.

76' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alban Lafont with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lyon.
76' A corner kick by Lyon is thwarted by the well prepared Alban Lafont (Nantes).
76' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him! Lyon win a corner.
74' Jocelyn Gourvennec prepares a substitution. Jean-Kevin Duverne is replaced by Kader Bamba (Nantes).
73' Some great controlled play and passing from Nantes. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
70' That will be all from Pedro Chirivella who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Moussa Sissoko (Nantes).
66' Eray Comert (Nantes) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
65' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
65' The total number of attempts is 5:5.
64' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is able to continue to play.
64' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
62' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' The game is interrupted now, Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' Moses Simon (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
61' Nantes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
61' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Nantes win a corner kick.
60' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
60' Florent Mollet (Nantes) will take a corner kick.
55' A player from Nantes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Florent Mollet (Nantes), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
53' The corner from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is intercepted by Alban Lafont.
52' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
49' 1 - 0 Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
49' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' A player from Nantes commits a rough challenge. Benoit Bastien blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Lyon.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Matthis Abline (Nantes) is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed.
46' Jocelyn Gourvennec makes a half-time substitution. Marcus Coco comes on in place of Fabien Centonze (Nantes).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
44' Lyon force their opponents to concede a corner.
43' The number of offsides is – 2:1.
41' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Anthony Lopes comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' Moses Simon (Nantes) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
39' Florent Mollet (Nantes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
37' Anthony Lopes comes off his line to intercept the corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes).

35' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
35' Chance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Alban Lafont is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
34' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
34' Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

33' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His precise header looks to be going inside the right post, but Alban Lafont is alert and somehow manages to keep the ball out.
33' Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.

33' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Lyon are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes). Benoit Bastien doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' Nantes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
30' An attempted cross from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared.
29' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
28' Florent Mollet (Nantes) sends the corner into the box, but Anthony Lopes intercepts it and averts the threat.
26' A pass by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
25' Florent Mollet (Nantes) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
24' The foul by Matthis Abline (Nantes) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 39:61.
19' One of the Lyon players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
18' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the direct free kick from the edge of the box, but his shot flies wide of the target. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
18' Poor challenge! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is penalised for tripping and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. A free kick to Nantes.
16' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) sends a long cross over to Florent Mollet, but Anthony Lopes comes forward to gather the ball.
14' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
12' The game is interrupted as Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is flagged offside.
11' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
9' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Rayan Cherki (Lyon), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
8' Lyon have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
8' The foul by Fabien Centonze (Nantes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benoit Bastien.
7' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
6' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Lyon.
5' Lyon take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
4' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' Moses Simon (Nantes) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
2' The game is pretty dull as Nantes are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Benoit Bastien.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
